Needs changes before merge.

The router words retain `Kind::Mill`. The UI and MCP read the same setup-specific option list. Existing sheet jobs and corner relief stay visible on a mill. The six new UI and app checks pass.

Results merged with main, locally:
- PR head: `afa612d2f30609a4c68063c005c7d10b0b30dd87`.
- Main: `5c8340b812a36ff1eb8d4d3326cde43f42ab3fed`. The trial merge has no conflicts. I checked the laws from this main.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 50 of 51 steps pass. All three builds pass. Tests: 2,022 pass, seven fail, seven are ignored. The seven failures need a graphics adapter. Both new UI checks and all four `router_kind` tests pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passes.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: all 205 steps pass in 22.7 minutes. There are 43 passing tests. Four registered known failures fail as expected: three for #2849 and one for #1950. The gate checks them separately. There are no unexpected heavy failures.

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no test fixture, golden, STEP file, or importer. The extra-suite selection rules add no suites.

Mutations: not run. This change adds router names and UI visibility rules. It retains the mill posting and safety rules. I found no change to G-code output, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No golden moves.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_sheet_job_row.rs:34` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/kind_editors.rs:169`: add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the changed Sheet job and corner relief controls for a router and a mill. The body has no screenshots. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, then link them from the body. Do not add images to this PR branch.

Environment limit, not a code finding:
Six `egui_app::report_tests` cases fail with:
```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```
`egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` also fails with:
```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
```
The full message says that Metal found no adapters. These seven cases remain unverified on this headless machine. The quick gate is not green here.

Addressed: none. The screenshot finding remains open.

The latest review requests before/after screenshots of Sheet job and corner relief for a router and a mill.

This machine cannot capture the controls. Native capture fails with `could not create image from display`. The app renderer reports `No adapter found`. Metal finds no adapters. The current screenshot harness requires a graphics adapter.

Evidence on unchanged head `afa612d2f30609a4c68063c005c7d10b0b30dd87`:
- `the_sheet_job_group_shows_on_a_router_and_not_on_a_mill` passes.
- `relief_row_shows_on_a_router_and_not_on_a_mill` passes.
- All four `router_kind` tests pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: red. 50 of 51 steps pass. Tests: 2,022 pass, seven fail, seven are ignored. All seven failures require a graphics adapter.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passes.

No source files changed. No new pin or mutation check applies to this screenshot-only finding. No images or evidence files were committed. No new head was pushed. The PR remains a draft.

Please re-review this head. The screenshot finding needs capture on a machine with an available graphics adapter and display.

Addressed: finding 1 (before/after screenshots of Sheet job and corner relief, for a router and a mill).

What changed:
- The PR body has a new "Screenshots" section. It links eight images: Sheet job and corner relief, router and mill, before and after.
- "Before" is `upstream/main` `03e05a649`. "After" is the PR head `afa612d2f`.
- The images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, commit `3f3c32e72`, folder `3279/`. No image is on the PR branch.
- I captured them on a Linux machine that has a graphics adapter. I used `Harness::render()` in a temporary test. I did not commit that test.

What the images show:
- Mill (VMC 3-axis): before, the Sheet job group and the Corner relief row show. After, the two do not show.
- Router (Tormach 24R): before and after, the two show.

Pins (unchanged): `the_sheet_job_group_shows_on_a_router_and_not_on_a_mill` and `relief_row_shows_on_a_router_and_not_on_a_mill`. The finding asks only for images, so no new pin or mutation check applies.

Head: `afa612d2f30609a4c68063c005c7d10b0b30dd87` (unchanged; no push, because no source file changed).

Gate on this head, on the machine with a graphics adapter:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green, 51 steps, 0 failed. `ui suites: lib` passes, with the seven adapter cases that failed on the review machine.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

The PR stays a draft. Please re-review this head.

The finding was already addressed before this pass. No source change, new pin, or mutation check applies to this screenshot-only finding. The plain push reports `Everything up-to-date`. The head is unchanged. The PR stays a draft. No labels changed.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings remain.

This is a new review of the same head after the author's later evidence comments.
The earlier screenshot finding is met. I opened all eight images linked in the PR body.
Sheet job and Corner relief stay visible for the router. They become hidden for the mill.
The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, at `3f3c32e72e5a94fa48a88a98c7769b78e7437cb9`.
That commit changes only the eight PNG files under `3279/`. The PR diff contains no images.

What looks good:
- Router words read as `Kind::Mill`. The existing mill rules still apply.
- The UI and MCP read the same setup-specific router option list.
- A stated sheet job or corner relief stays visible on a mill.
- All four `router_kind` tests pass. Both new UI visibility tests pass.

Results, trial-merged with main and run locally:
- PR head: `afa612d2f30609a4c68063c005c7d10b0b30dd87`.
- Main: `9e8e2135cd4cc580ccb91dfd2ec504c16c9950c7`. The trial merge has no conflicts.
- I checked the laws from this main's `AGENTS.md` and `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green. All 51 steps pass in 7.3 minutes.
  All three builds pass. Tests: 2,045 pass, zero fail, seven are ignored.
  The UI library has 1,424 passes. The rendering tests that lacked an adapter in the earlier review now pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: green. All 204 steps pass in 59.7 minutes.
  Tests: 46 pass. Two registered failures, for #1950 and #2849, fail as expected.
  The gate checks those failures separately. There are no unexpected heavy failures.
- Light selection: the current light plan has only motion steps (`lib` and `adaptive_troch_parallel`).
  It has no app steps. `cargo xtask gate light --only app` reports no matching step; it runs no tests.
- The first quick process ended with signal 15 during the app build. A complete foreground rerun passed as stated above.

Extra suites run: none required by the fixture and importer selection rules.
The diff changes no test fixture, golden, STEP file, or importer.

Mutations: not run. This change adds router names and UI visibility rules.
It does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry.
The six machine files change only the kind word from mill to router. Both words select the same mill rules.
No golden moves. A SAFETY-tier mutation rerun does not apply.

Coordinator: this PR merges by the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-21 ("merge using the recommended option"; a reviewed `feat` merges now). The review that this merge relies on is mkinney's collaborator `pr-reviewer` marker on head afa612d2f (clean). I read the machine-file change: the six machine files change only `"kind": "mill"` to `"kind": "router"`, and `Kind::from_word` reads `router` as `Kind::Mill`, so every mill rule (axes, spindle, post) is unchanged and no machine loses a tool or an option. The body has the UI screenshots. I merge it on head afa612d2f. It is a fork PR, so its branch stays.

The post-merge gate of this merge is red. Run: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45007275047 (commit 9d2565216).

- Failed step: `app suites: machine`, `tests/machine.rs`, test `a_kind_that_is_not_a_kind_refuses_at_the_door`.
- The run of the commit before it (bc9c73d7f) is not complete yet. The run before that (adca662d4) is green.
- The issue is #3337 (`main is red (post-merge gate)`, P2).

This PR added the router kind. Please check if the test uses a kind name that is now a legal kind. If you fix it, claim #3337 first.
